original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Tooling/framework only, no word and no kappa claim: a patched copy of the complex interval gate (interval_gate_signed.py) whose input-lift check uses the signed (negative-coefficient) curvature 51.137 instead of the absolute 94.216 and whose default BIT pin is the admitted ordinary BIT saving .00385248 instead of .00376669, with a Lean lemma for the lift positivity, a 32-case regression test and the diff against the pinned original.
scope_change_reason: The replay-runtime card asks for a measured replay speed-up. This package removes two certification ceilings (+2.98%/+3.24% over the frontier) in the gate used to replay complex-word claims; it makes no speed claim. Recorded as changed.
bottleneck_link: Side result (tooling). The pinned gate certifies complex words only up to kappa about .00376669 (+2.98% over #7617). Words between that and the admitted BIT saving .00385248 (+5.33%) could not be certified by the official check although the same premises cover them.
stop_rule: Keep the package only if tests/gate_test.py reproduces all 32 expected outcomes (pinned original passes the #7000 recorded invoice and reproduces its recorded fields; signed gate passes #7617/#7615 and rejects every corrupted invoice, mutant and over-ceiling case); otherwise report the failing case.
evidence: VERIFY.json runs tests/gate_test.py: 32/32 expected outcomes; independent audit verdict SOUND with caveats C1-C5 applied (new file, ceiling stated as pin - 7g, pin assert, Lean import for the repo pin, inherited limits stated).
